patch_description:
This crossover combines the current program’s diverse structured/random restart portfolio with the inspiration program’s log-distance contact gradient, checkpoint rollback, and exact-monotone multiscale polishing.

The continuation stage explores several contact graphs efficiently using normalized momentum updates. It retains exact objective checkpoints and restarts from the local best state when a surrogate trajectory degrades. The final portfolio polish only accepts candidate steps that improve the evaluator-equivalent squared ratio, including multiple line-search scales and deterministic transverse perturbations. This preserves reproducibility while making the final refinement robust around nonsmooth active-contact transitions.
